lines.text: One word on the radio. Then the batteries *died.*
lines.style: First-person survivor, hushed and frustrated, gravelly, a beat of dread on the last word.

lines.text: We needed new ones. The only place close was the *pharmacy.*
lines.style: Narrating quietly at night, wary, steady pace.
Teenage girl whispering in terror, very quiet, urgent.
Teenage girl, out of breath after swinging a bat, flat and deadpan, relieved.

lines.text: The battery shelf was empty. Picked *clean.*
But Biscuit found a box under the counter.
lines.style: Narrating, hope creeping back, a small smile in the voice.

lines.text: This is Gull Point. The *lighthouse* is a safe zone. Fifty miles north. We keep the lights on at night.
lines.style: A calm, tired man reading an emergency radio message that repeats on a loop, clear and steady, slightly mechanical.
Teenage girl, quiet but determined, no doubt in her voice.

lines.text: Then the bell above the door *rang.*
lines.style: Whispered narration, sudden fear, the last word almost breathless.

music.title: Last Light - The Signal
music.style: Cinematic horror survival score. Starts as a tense, creeping night soundscape: low pulsing synth, ticking percussion, uneasy plucked strings, rising dread. In the middle it opens into a fragile, hopeful theme with warm strings and a soft piano melody, like a distant light. It ends with a sudden cold, dark drone and a tense swell. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under dialogue.
